name: BoldKit
summary: MIT free neubrutalism React/Vue shadcn registry with 55+ comps, charts, and shapes.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 55+ BoldKit React UI components (Vue/Nuxt variants not ingested).
Requires components.json registries.@boldkit = https://boldkit.dev/r/{name}.json for scoped deps.
Distinct from existing SoT id neobrutalism — different project/registry.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @boldkit/button

# Registry: https://boldkit.dev/r/button.json
# Demo: https://boldkit.dev/docs/components/button
# Requires registries.@boldkit = https://boldkit.dev/r/{name}.json in components.json

copyPrompt.text: Use BoldKit free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://boldkit.dev/docs/components/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @boldkit/button` (registry https://boldkit.dev/r/{name}.json; add @boldkit alias first). Alt CLI: `npx boldkit add button`. Home/docs: https://boldkit.dev. Repo: https://github.com/anibit14/boldkit. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anibit14/boldkit/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2025 BoldKit). Pricing free.
